results.question: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT test are exclusively virtual?
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.School) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F' AND T1.AvgScrMath > 400
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) FROM schools s INNER JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND sc.AvgScrMath > 400;

results.question: Please list the codes of the schools with a total enrollment of over 500.
results.gold_sql: SELECT T2.CDSCode FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` + T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500
results.sql: SELECT s.CDSCode FROM schools s INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500 LIMIT 50;

results.question: Rank schools by their average score in Writing where the score is greater than 499, showing their charter numbers.
results.gold_sql: SELECT CharterNum, AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM schools AS T1  INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T2.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND CharterNum is not null

results.question: What is the average number of test takers from Fresno schools that opened between 1/1/1980 and 12/31/1980?
results.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' AND T2.County = 'Fresno'
results.sql: SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS avg_test_takers FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno'   AND sc.OpenDate >= '1980-01-01' AND sc.OpenDate <= '1980-12-31';

results.question: List the names of virtual schools that are among the top 5 in their respective counties based on average reading scores.
results.gold_sql: SELECT School FROM (SELECT T2.School,T1.AvgScrRead, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY T2.County ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F' ) ranked_schools WHERE rnk <= 5
results.sql: WITH ranked AS (     SELECT          s.CDSCode,         s.School,         s.County,         s.Virtual,         sc.AvgScrRead,         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sc.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk     FROM schools s     JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds     WHERE sc.rtype = 'S' AND sc.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL ) SELECT School FROM ranked WHERE Virtual = 'F' AND rnk <= 5 ORDER BY County, rnk LIMIT 50;

results.question: Which are the cards that have incredibly powerful foils.
results.gold_sql: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
results.sql: SELECT name, power, toughness, manaCost, setCode, rarity FROM cards WHERE hasFoil = 1 AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10 LIMIT 50;

results.question: What are the borderless cards available without powerful foils?
results.gold_sql: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE borderColor = 'borderless' AND (cardKingdomId IS NULL OR cardKingdomId IS NULL)
results.sql: SELECT name, setCode, borderColor, hasFoil FROM cards WHERE borderColor = 'borderless' AND hasFoil = 0 LIMIT 50;

results.question: How many cards have infinite power?
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power = '*'
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power = '*';

results.question: What is the border color of card "Ancestor's Chosen"?
results.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT borderColor FROM cards WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
results.sql: SELECT borderColor FROM cards WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' LIMIT 1;

results.question: What is the rule of playing card "Benalish Knight"?
results.gold_sql: SELECT T2.format FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.name = 'Benalish Knight'
results.sql: SELECT text FROM cards WHERE name = 'Benalish Knight' LIMIT 1;

results.question: Which user has a higher reputation, Harlan or Jarrod Dixon?
results.gold_sql: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon') AND Reputation = ( SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon') )
results.sql: SELECT DisplayName, Reputation FROM users WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon') ORDER BY Reputation DESC LIMIT 50;

results.question: Please list the display names of all the users whose accounts were created in the year 2011.
results.gold_sql: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011'
results.sql: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011' LIMIT 50;

results.question: How many users last accessed the website after 2014/9/1?
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM users WHERE date(LastAccessDate) > '2014-09-01'
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users WHERE LastAccessDate > '2014-09-01';

results.question: How many posts does the user csgillespie own?
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie')

results.question: Who is the owner of the post "Eliciting priors from experts"?
results.gold_sql: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts'
results.sql: SELECT users.DisplayName FROM posts JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id WHERE posts.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts' LIMIT 1;

results.question: What is the ratio of customers who pay in EUR against customers who pay in CZK?
results.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(Currency = 'EUR', 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) / SUM(IIF(Currency = 'CZK', 1, 0)) AS ratio FROM customers
results.sql: SELECT Currency, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY Currency;

results.question: How much did customer 6 consume in total between August and November 2013?
results.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = 6 AND Date BETWEEN '201308' AND '201311'
results.sql: SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = 6 AND Date BETWEEN 201308 AND 201311

results.question: How many more "discount" gas stations does the Czech Republic have compared to Slovakia?
results.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(IIF(Country = 'CZE', 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(Country = 'SVK', 1, 0)) FROM gasstations WHERE Segment = 'Discount'
results.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE Country = 'CZE' AND Segment = 'discount') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE Country = 'SVK' AND Segment = 'discount') AS difference;

results.question: Is it true that more SMEs pay in Czech koruna than in euros? If so, how many more?
results.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Currency = 'CZK') - SUM(Currency = 'EUR') FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME'
results.sql: SELECT Currency, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME' GROUP BY Currency;

results.question: In February 2012, what percentage of customers consumed more than 528.3?
results.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(Consumption > 528.3, 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(CustomerID) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date = '201202'
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage FROM yearmonth WHERE Date = '201202';

results.question: Give the team_fifa_api_id of teams with more than 50 but less than 60 build-up play speed.
results.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

results.question: Find the average number of long-shot done by Ahmed Samir Farag.
results.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.long_shots) AS REAL) / COUNT(t2.`date`) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag'
results.sql: SELECT AVG(pa.long_shots) AS avg_long_shots FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag'

results.question: List the football players with a birthyear of 1970 and a birthmonth of October.
results.gold_sql: SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 7) = '1970-10'
results.sql: SELECT player_name, player_api_id, birthday FROM Player WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', birthday) AS INTEGER) = 1970 AND CAST(strftime('%m', birthday) AS INTEGER) = 10 LIMIT 50;

results.question: What is the overall rating of the football player Gabriel Tamas in year 2011?
results.gold_sql: SELECT t2.overall_rating FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas' AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) = '2011'
results.sql: SELECT pa.overall_rating FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas' AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) = '2011' LIMIT 50;

results.question: Which player is older, Aaron Lennon or Abdelaziz Barrada?
results.gold_sql: SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE player_name IN ('Aaron Lennon', 'Abdelaziz Barrada') ORDER BY birthday ASC LIMIT 1
results.sql: SELECT player_name, birthday FROM Player WHERE player_name IN ('Aaron Lennon', 'Abdelaziz Barrada')

results.question: List out the no. of districts that have female average salary is more than 6000 but less than 10000?

results.question: How many accounts who choose issuance after transaction are staying in East Bohemia region?

results.question: How many male customers who are living in North Bohemia have average salary greater than 8000?
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'M' AND T2.A3 = 'north Bohemia' AND T2.A11 > 8000

results.question: What is the surname of the driver with the best lap time in race number 19 in the second qualifying period?
results.gold_sql: SELECT T2.surname FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 19 ORDER BY T1.q2 ASC LIMIT 1
results.sql: SELECT d.surname FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 19 AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY q.q2 ASC LIMIT 1

results.question: Please give the name of the race held on the circuits in Germany.
results.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.name FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T1.country = 'Germany'
results.sql: SELECT r.name FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'Germany' LIMIT 50;

results.question: What is the coordinates location of the circuits for Australian grand prix?
results.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
results.sql: SELECT c.name AS circuit_name, c.location, c.country, c.lat, c.lng FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name LIKE '%Australian Grand Prix%' LIMIT 50;

results.question: Give the coordinate position for Abu Dhabi Grand Prix.
results.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'
results.sql: SELECT c.lat, c.lng FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix' LIMIT 1;

results.question: What's Bruno Senna's Q1 result in the qualifying race No. 354?
results.gold_sql: SELECT T1.q1 FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 354 AND T2.forename = 'Bruno' AND T2.surname = 'Senna'
results.sql: SELECT q.q1 FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 354 AND d.forename = 'Bruno' AND d.surname = 'Senna'

results.question: What's Angela Sanders's major?
results.gold_sql: SELECT T2.major_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Angela' AND T1.last_name = 'Sanders'
results.sql: SELECT m.major_name FROM member mem JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id WHERE mem.first_name = 'Angela' AND mem.last_name = 'Sanders' LIMIT 1

results.question: What is the amount of the funds that the Vice President received?

results.sql: SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_funds FROM income i JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE m.position = 'Vice President'

results.question: List the full name of the Student_Club members that grew up in Illinois state.
results.gold_sql: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code WHERE T2.state = 'Illinois'
results.sql: SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name FROM member m JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE z.state = 'Illinois';

results.question: What was the notes of the fundraising on 2019/9/14?
results.gold_sql: SELECT notes FROM income WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14'
results.sql: SELECT notes FROM event WHERE event_date = '2019-09-14'

results.question: Tell the phone number of "Carlo Jacobs".
results.gold_sql: SELECT phone FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Carlo' AND last_name = 'Jacobs'
results.sql: SELECT phone FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Carlo' AND last_name = 'Jacobs' LIMIT 1;

results.question: Please list all the superpowers of 3-D Man.
results.gold_sql: SELECT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = '3-D Man'
results.sql: SELECT sp.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE s.superhero_name = '3-D Man'

results.question: What is Copycat's race?
results.gold_sql: SELECT T2.race FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Copycat'
results.sql: SELECT r.race FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Copycat' LIMIT 1;

results.question: Which superheroes have a durability attribute value of less than 50?
results.gold_sql: SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hero_attribute AS T2 INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'Durability' AND T2.attribute_value < 50 AND T1.id = T2.hero_id)
results.sql: SELECT s.superhero_name, ha.attribute_value AS durability_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Durability' AND ha.attribute_value < 50 LIMIT 50;

results.question: Give the publisher ID of Star Trek.
results.gold_sql: SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek'
results.sql: SELECT p.id FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Star Trek' LIMIT 1;

results.question: What is the total number of superheroes without full name?
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL OR full_name = '-';

results.question: What is the disease patient '30609' diagnosed with. List all the date of laboratory tests done for this patient.
results.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Diagnosis, T2.Date FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ID = 30609
results.sql: SELECT p.Diagnosis, l.Date AS Laboratory_Date FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.ID = '30609' ORDER BY l.Date;

results.question: List the patient ID, sex and birthday of patient with LDH beyond normal range.
results.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH > 500
results.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday FROM Patient p INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.LDH > 280 OR l.LDH < 140 LIMIT 50;

results.question: For patients with severe degree of thrombosis, list their ID, sex and disease the patient is diagnosed with.
results.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
results.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, e.Diagnosis FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE e.Thrombosis = 'severe' LIMIT 50;

results.question: What are the symptoms observed by the youngest patient to ever did a medical examination? Identify their diagnosis.
results.gold_sql: SELECT T2.Symptoms, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC LIMIT 1
results.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.Birthday, e."Examination Date", e.Symptoms, e.Diagnosis FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE (julianday(e."Examination Date") - julianday(p.Birthday)) = (SELECT MIN(julianday(e2."Examination Date") - julianday(p2.Birthday)) FROM Patient p2 JOIN Examination e2 ON p2.ID = e2.ID) LIMIT 50;

results.question: How many female patients were given an APS diagnosis?
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS'
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_aps_count FROM Patient p WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND (     p.ID IN (SELECT e.ID FROM Examination e WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%APS%')     OR     p.Diagnosis LIKE '%APS%' );

results.question: What is the most common bond type?
results.gold_sql: SELECT T.bond_type FROM ( SELECT bond_type, COUNT(bond_id) FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T
results.sql: SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS freq FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY freq DESC LIMIT 1;

results.question: Find the triple-bonded molecules which are carcinogenic.
results.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#' AND T2.label = '+'
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '+';

results.question: What is the percentage of molecules that are carcinogenic? Please provide your answer as a percentage with three decimal places.
results.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.label = '+' THEN T.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.molecule_id),3) FROM molecule t
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 3) AS percentage FROM molecule;

results.question: How many connections does the atom 19 have?
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T.bond_id) FROM connected AS T WHERE SUBSTR(T.atom_id, -2) = '19'

results.question: What are the atoms of the triple bond with the molecule "TR041"?
results.gold_sql: SELECT T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#' AND T3.molecule_id = 'TR041'
results.sql: SELECT a.atom_id, a.element FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#' LIMIT 50;
